hypotheses.persona: Standard Office Worker with Creative Hobby
hypotheses.rationale: The rigid 08:40 departure and 18:36 return pattern persists. Day 4 shows no deviation in timing. The tablet at 07:36 suggests a morning routine (news/email) before work, consistent with an office worker. The lack of weekend-specific evidence yet keeps this dominant.

Still possible if the person has a fixed client schedule or commute requirement. The tablet usage could imply remote work prep, but the strict physical departure (backpack/keys) makes this less likely than the office worker hypothesis.
Remains unlikely due to the rigid schedule and possession of keys. No new evidence (e.g., textbooks, library items) supports this. Probability remains low and static.
